name: EQ Artist
author: Slow Ops Music
summary: 8-band EQ you edit two ways over a live spectrum: drag colour-coded band nodes, or paint the curve with a finger and it becomes real bands. Bell, shelves, 6 to 48 dB/oct cuts and notch, with zero-latency filters that keep their analog shape near 20 kHz, undo/redo, and a pre/post analyser.
